description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the Category Management API of a web application. It includes methods to test retrieving, creating, and deleting categories via REST endpoints, using Spring's RestTemplate for HTTP calls, and JUnit annotations for test definitions.

classes.name: CategoryManagementAPITest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the Category Management REST API. Contains test methods for retrieving, creating, and deleting categories, with helper method for setting HTTP headers including Basic Authentication.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Creates HTTP headers with JSON content type and Basic Authentication for API requests.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Test method to retrieve a category by ID from the API endpoint.

methods.name: postCategory
methods.description: Test method to create a new category by sending a POST request with category data.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Test method to delete a category by ID via the API endpoint.
